judged_text: The new loadUsers validation throws plain Error("dynamicUserList is not properly defined or empty."), which the catch's `instanceof HttpError || instanceof Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError` checks do not match, so those errors fall through to the generic 500 branch. adjudication.rationale: In `packages/features/bookings/lib/handleNewBooking.ts`, `loadUsers` now throws plain `Error` for validation (e.g. `throw new Error("dynamicUserList is not properly defined or empty.")`). The surrounding `catch` only maps `HttpError` or `Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError` to a 400; any other error (including these validation `Error`s) falls through to `throw new HttpError({ statusCode: 500, message: "Unable to load users" })`. So invalid/empty `dynamicUserList` will incorrectly produce a 500 instead of a 4xx with the intended message, matching the finding.
